# Nova

> Nova is an open-source, self-hosted multi-agent AI orchestration platform. A team of 24 specialist agents plus an automation layer runs your operation from Telegram, Slack, Discord, or a terminal — on your own model subscriptions and your own machine. It prepares work freely, then asks before anything ships, spends, or sends. MIT licensed.

Nova drives the official vendor CLIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex) as subprocesses, so it runs on subscriptions you already pay for rather than metered API tokens; it also supports any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Storage is local SQLite with vector search; embeddings and the knowledge base run locally. Consequential actions pass a human approval gate. Source: https://github.com/djbelieny/nova

Every page on this site is available as clean Markdown by appending `/index.md` to its URL. Spanish and Brazilian-Portuguese translations live under `/es/` and `/pt-br/`.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://mynova.space/docs/index.md): Full install, configuration, channels, approvals, the 24 agents, skills, memory and intent tags, knowledge base, AI providers, and the executive board — the complete reference.
- [What is Nova](https://mynova.space/index.md): Home page — the one-screen overview of the platform, the request pipeline, and the trust model.

## Blog

- [Boards your agents fill in](https://mynova.space/blog/workboards/index.md): Nova can now build you a board. Ask for one in chat, it proposes the fields and stages, agents fill the cards, and you drag them in the dashboard. Stages can run a playbook when a card lands. Enough to replace a light CRM.
- [Nova runs the operation now: playbooks, automations & connectors](https://mynova.space/blog/business-automation/index.md): Nova's biggest release turns it event-driven and process-durable: playbooks (reusable SOPs), event automations with semantic triggers, durable multi-day processes, document extraction, business connectors (Stripe/Shopify/Zendesk/HubSpot), compliance policies, and ROI reporting — every consequential step still gated.
- [Give Nova a second brain: feed it your documents with RAG](https://mynova.space/blog/second-brain/index.md): Nova now has a scoped knowledge base — a second brain. Drop in PDFs, docs, notes, or URLs and Nova learns them: chunked, embedded locally, and retrieved across every agent with source citations. Personal, team, and per-agent scopes. Four ways to feed it.
- [Nova, production-hardened: governance, exactly-once & connected data](https://mynova.space/blog/governance-hardening/index.md): The hardening release: hard-block compliance policies, role-based permissions, out-of-office delegation, durable exactly-once idempotency, advisory locks, encrypted connector secrets, connectors agents can discover like MCP tools, and a connected-data layer — everything you need to run Nova unattended, for a team.
- [Nova vs. Hermes vs. OpenClaw: the good, the bad, and the ugly](https://mynova.space/blog/nova-vs-hermes-vs-openclaw/index.md): An honest, sourced comparison of three self-hosted, open-source AI agents — OpenClaw, Hermes, and Nova — with a feature table, charts, and the good, the bad, and the ugly of each.
- [Nova speaks every model now](https://mynova.space/blog/whats-new/index.md): A batch of upgrades: run any OpenAI-compatible model alongside your subscription CLIs, a real nova command with nova connect, terminal + Discord channels, and self-serve team invites — without touching the self-hosted, approval-gated trust model.
- [Every feature Nova has, and what they're built to do](https://mynova.space/blog/features/index.md): 24 specialist agents, an executive board, earned autonomy, two-phase approval, persistent memory with semantic recall, 12 MCP integrations, 45 skills, proactive services, and full audit trails. Here's everything Nova can do.
- [How Nova works: the architecture under the hood](https://mynova.space/blog/architecture/index.md): A technical deep dive into Nova's architecture: 3-tier message classification, task decomposition with dependency resolution, parallel execution, two-phase approval gates, split SQLite with vector search, and intelligent AI routing across Claude, Gemini, and Codex.
- [Why Nova is built the way it is](https://mynova.space/blog/design-decisions/index.md): The philosophy behind Nova's architecture: why an org chart instead of a chatbot, why trust is engineered, why autonomy must be earned, and why sandboxing and auditability are non-negotiable.
- [Deploying Nova: A practical guide to self-hosting](https://mynova.space/blog/deployment/index.md): Self-host Nova in under 5 minutes. From the init wizard to production on a VPS, here's everything you need to know to run your own AI team on your machine, your keys, your approval gates.
- [A week launching a product with Nova](https://mynova.space/blog/case-study/index.md): How a solo founder used Nova to launch a new product feature: strategy board, concurrent agent work, approval gates, and earned autonomy. An illustrative walkthrough.
- [What is Nova? Your open-source AI team, explained](https://mynova.space/blog/what-is-nova/index.md): Nova is a self-hosted, open-source AI team you run from Telegram: 24 specialist agents, an executive board, human approval before anything ships or spends, sandboxed execution, and earned autonomy. Here's what it does and how people use it.
